mcqs.question: India–China border trade via which Himalayan pass in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, resumed after six years in March 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Border trade between India and China via Lipulekh Pass in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, resumed after six years. Nathu La is in Sikkim, Shipki La is in Himachal Pradesh, and Zoji La is in Kargil, Ladakh.
